# Learning Loop

Every task completes `SKILL-LEARNING.md`, even when no reusable lesson exists. Evidence advances through OBSERVED → PROPOSED → REPRODUCED → VALIDATED → CANDIDATE → STABLE. DEPRECATED marks obsolete guidance.

Run `rdp-ai learn` only after declaring the lesson GENERAL and completing sanitization. The generated proposal is still local and requires its own Skill PR, domain review, regression evidence and release approval. Customer-specific material remains in the customer project.
